item.title: Pixel 10 and Galaxy S26 owners just gained the first genuine AI assistant
item.description: Google Gemini has just gained the ability to start carrying out tasks on your behalf, making rivals like Siri look dumb, though not everyone will be able to make use of it. As predicted, owners of the Google Pixel 10 (not including the new Pixel 10a, unsurprisingly) and Samsung Galaxy S26 series will soon be able to hand off select tasks to Google’s Gemini AI. item.title: A cheaper Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 7 alternative is now just days away
item.description: A more affordable alternative to the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 7 is right around the corner, as Motorola announces the full reveal of its Razr Fold. Motorola has issued a brief post on X, promising to move “Past the preview, into every detail” on 2 March at MWC 2026. item.title: When is Scream 7 available to stream, rent and buy?
item.description: Ghostface, the masked killer and scary movie expert, is returning in a new film. Scream 7, directed by Kevin Williamson, focuses on Sidney Prescott-Evans (Neve Campbell), the film series protagonist. But this time around, it’s her daughter Tatum (Isabel May) who is targeted. To protect her child, Sidney must discover who’s hiding behind the mask. As usual, she has the help of feisty journalist Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox).
